title: Guide: {{page}}
everyPage: Every page has its own guide — open it from the top of the side menu.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: The whole programme at a glance for the project picked in the side menu.

project.meaning: A district (analysed by block) or a state (analysed by district). Every admin page shows the project picked in the side menu.

learner.meaning: A health worker registered on NurtureHUB (ASHA, ANM, AWW, Staff Nurse …).

f2f.meaning: Face-to-face training — the in-person training learners are selected for after the screening test.

projects.name: Projects
projects.intro: Set up states and districts, their codes and whether a district uses its state's content.

state.meaning: Holds district projects; its reports are split by district.

district.meaning: A project of its own; its reports are split by block.

inherits.meaning: The district serves its state's videos, tests and forms instead of its own.

code.meaning: Short project code used in analysis files (UJ, JL, ML …).

learners.name: Learners
learners.intro: Every registered account: search, correct details, move someone to another project.

userId.meaning: The learner's unique number on NurtureHUB — the surest way to find a learner. Type it in any search box.

verified.meaning: The learner confirmed their email with the one-time code.

project.meaning: The district or state the learner is trained under.

formBuilder.name: Form Builder
formBuilder.intro: Every data-collection form, its versions, and which version each project uses.

lr.meaning: Learner Registration — the profile a health worker completes when joining.

mr.meaning: Mother Registration — details captured when a learner registers a mother.

cr.meaning: Child Registration — details captured when a child is added under a mother.

bfa.meaning: Breastfeeding Assessment — the learner observes a breastfeed and records each step.

cfa.meaning: Complementary Feeding Assessment — what the baby ate and how, from 150 days of age.

cg.meaning: Check Growth — the child's weight and length at a visit, with feeding and illness questions.

anc.meaning: Antenatal care — the pregnant mother's visit record.

pca.meaning: Protein Count Assessment — the mother's protein intake recall.

lap.meaning: Green verdict: the practice matches what was taught. Red (Needs tutorial): the learner is shown coaching.

version.meaning: Every saved change is a new version; a project can be pinned to one, others get the default.

questions.meaning: One Excel of every question with its limits and skip patterns, for reviewing what changes per project.

tutorials.name: Videos
tutorials.intro: The training videos learners watch, phase by phase, with their quizzes.

phase.meaning: A stage of the course: videos, then a test, then the next phase.

quiz.meaning: Short questions after a video; they do not count towards the test.

tutorialTracking.name: Tutorial tracking
tutorialTracking.intro: How much of each video every learner watched, and how they did on its quiz.

watch.meaning: How much of the video the learner actually played.

quiz.meaning: Whether the learner answered the video's quiz, skipped it, or has not reached it.

accuracy.meaning: Share of quiz questions answered right.

score.meaning: One number for video learning, out of 100: 60% average watch % + 20% quiz participation + 20% quiz accuracy (just the watch % when there are no quizzes).

tests.name: Test manager
tests.intro: Create and schedule the tests; open the live monitor while one is running.

ft.meaning: The learning check after the videos. Everyone goes on to the next phase whether they pass or not.

st.meaning: The final test; selection for face-to-face training follows from it.

pass.meaning: The lowest score (%) that counts as passing.

attempts.meaning: How many times a learner may write the test.

liveMonitor.name: Live monitor
liveMonitor.intro: Watch candidates while they write: progress, warnings and suspicious activity, as it happens.

risk.meaning: 0–100, built up from suspicious events: many tab switches (+10/+15), leaving full screen (+8), copy/paste (+20), answering in under 2 seconds (+5), jumping between questions without answering (+10).

tabs.meaning: Times the candidate left the test tab.

fs.meaning: Times the candidate left full-screen mode.

cp.meaning: Copy, paste or right-click during the test.

idle.meaning: Connected but silent for 90 seconds or more.

flag.meaning: Marked for review by an admin or by the rules above.

results.name: Results
results.intro: How learners did on the videos and tests, for the whole project or any group of it.

ft.meaning: The learner's best score (%) on the formative test, with ✓ passed or ✗ not passed.

st.meaning: The learner's best score (%) on the screening test.

videos.meaning: Videos finished out of all videos, with average watch % and quizzes answered ✓ / skipped ⨯.

score.meaning: One number out of 100 for video learning: 60% average watch % + 20% quiz participation + 20% quiz accuracy.

risk.meaning: The highest proctoring risk score (0–100) across the learner's attempts.

tabs.meaning: Times the learner left the test tab.

fs.meaning: Times the learner left full-screen mode during the test.

cp.meaning: Copy, paste or right-click events during the test.

flow.meaning: Completed = every video watched and every test written; otherwise In progress.

bands.meaning: Needs support (well below the pass mark) · Near miss (within 20 points) · Passed · Excellent (85%+).

difficulty.meaning: A question answered right by 80%+ of writers is easy, 50–79% medium, below 50% difficult (first attempts).

split.meaning: Split by compares groups side by side. Filter by keeps only the ticked groups — e.g. HFW learners of two blocks — on every page.

first.meaning: Question analysis uses each learner's first attempt: a retake after seeing the paper measures memory, not knowledge.

userId.meaning: The learner's unique number. Search by it anywhere; mobile number and cadre are shown beside every name.

monitor.meaning: Split or filter by batch monitor to see each monitor's learners together (set on the MASD dashboard → Learners).

growth.name: Growth monitor
growth.intro: Every child's growth and the activities done for them, case by case.

bv.meaning: Baseline visit (first measurement), Assessment (mid) visit, Last visit.

wfaz.meaning: Weight-for-age z-score: below −2 underweight, below −3 severely underweight.

hfaz.meaning: Height (length)-for-age z-score: below −2 stunted, below −3 severely stunted.

wfhz.meaning: Weight-for-height z-score: below −2 wasted (MAM), below −3 severely wasted (SAM).

ec.meaning: Expected count — how many of a form should have been filled by now for the case.

ac.meaning: Actual count — how many were filled, and as a % of expected.

ic.meaning: Incomplete count — forms started but not finished, and as a % of expected.

cg.meaning: Check Growth · Breastfeeding assessment · Complementary feeding assessment · Antenatal care · Protein count.

fu.meaning: How long the case has been followed: in pregnancy, as a baby, before and after 195 days of age.

tranche.meaning: The batch of adoptions the case was adopted in (1st, 2nd, 3rd tranche).

layout.meaning: Tick column groups on or off and make rows compact — remembered in this browser.

masd.name: MASD dashboard
masd.intro: Member Activity Summary: are learners adopting mothers and doing the expected activities, and how are the children growing?

masd.meaning: Member Activity Summary Dashboard — the district report of adoptions, activities and outcomes.

tranche.meaning: A round of adoptions asked of each learner (e.g. 1 ANC + 1 PNC <5M + 1 PNC ≥5M).

anc.meaning: Mother adopted in pregnancy · after birth with the baby under 5 months · baby 5 months or older.

fu.meaning: Days considered for expected activities: days since a tranche opened, less its buffer, rounded down to the LAP table's 15-day steps (at most 270).

buffer.meaning: Days allowed after a tranche opens before activities are expected (7 for the first, 4 for later ones).

expected.meaning: How many of each form a learner should have filled by now, added up tranche by tranche.

codes.meaning: Growth monitoring · Breastfeeding · Complementary feeding · Protein intake forms.

sn.meaning: Staff Nurse — expected to do growth monitoring and breastfeeding only.

uptake.meaning: How quickly learners adopted after a tranche opened.

nfhs.meaning: National Family Health Survey — the district benchmark the outcomes are compared with.

severe.meaning: Below −3 z-scores — the children needing the most urgent attention.

monitor.meaning: A learner trusted to watch over a few others. Learners → Batch monitor marks one and gives learners their monitor; the table above lists, per monitor, who is on track and who needs a call.

level1.term: Level 1 — % of ideal expected activity fulfilled
level1.meaning: If every learner had adopted exactly what each tranche asked, on the day its buffer ended, the forms they should have filled by today. Example: asked 1 ANC + 1 PNC <5M + 1 PNC ≥5M in tranche 1 (105 days) and the same in tranche 2 (60 days) → 49 + 44 = 93 forms per learner.

level2.term: Level 2 — % fulfilled for the adoptions actually made
level2.meaning: The same rule, but only for the mothers each learner really adopted. Example: she adopted 1 ANC and 1 PNC <5M in tranche 1 and 1 PNC <5M in tranche 2 → 4 + 20 + 18 = 42 forms due.

level3.term: Level 3 — % fulfilled, each case by its own dates
level3.meaning: The same three mothers, each counted from her own adoption day (no buffer, no 15-day rounding), with a pregnancy's antenatal checks until the birth and then the baby's visits.

iqr.meaning: The middle value, with the range of the middle half of learners (25th–75th percentile). Used where a few extreme values would distort an average, e.g. nil-activity days.

visits.meaning: Birth visit · adoption visit · last visit — shown blue, orange, green. BV can be shown or hidden.

split.meaning: Split by groups the charts and tables (cadre, block, district, MT+FL, batch…); Filter by keeps only the ticked groups.

declared.meaning: The learner chooses the adoption type at registration; NurtureHUB also works it out from the dates. A difference is flagged for the learner and their batch monitor.

pace.meaning: A tranche's adoptions are all due the day its buffer ends, so the expected line rises straight up; its forms then fall due day by day on the LAP schedule.

dataProtection.name: Data protection
dataProtection.intro: Who opened or exported mother and child records, consent, retention and breaches.

phi.meaning: Personal health information — identified mother and child records.

audit.meaning: A tamper-evident record of every read, change and export of that information.

dpdp.meaning: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

rawData.name: Raw data
rawData.intro: Download the raw data in one place: the pipelines' input files, every test answer, and every form question.

answers.meaning: Learners down the rows, questions across: each learner's first-attempt answer, the same grid scored 1/0, and a question reference sheet.

forms.meaning: Every question of every form with its type, limits and skip patterns.

crosstabs.meaning: The nine CSV files the crosstabs pipeline reads, built from NurtureHUB's forms.

ingest.meaning: Copy the generated files into the pipeline's inputs so it can run.

crosstabs.name: Crosstabs pipeline
crosstabs.intro: Run the analysts' crosstab scripts on the latest raw data.

ct.meaning: Crosstab — a table of counts split by two variables (e.g. block × outcome).

exclusion.meaning: Cases left out of the analysis, with the reason, before the tables are made.

masdPipeline.name: MASD pipeline
masdPipeline.intro: Run the analysts' MASD scripts on the uploaded input files.

pool.meaning: The MASD CSVs per district that the run reads.
